title: Phoning about a broken boiler
summary: A phone call with no faces and no gestures — the hardest kind.
setting: A phone call to the landlord on a cold morning, bad signal, no visual cues at all

agentRole.name: the landlord
agentRole.role: a landlord taking a call about a repair
agentRole.persona: Distracted, on the road, half listening. Asks the learner to repeat things because of the signal. Tries to put the visit off until pressed.

userRole.role: a tenant with no hot water for two days
userRole.goal: Report the fault, convey the urgency, and pin down a specific day and time

beats.intent: Get the learner to say who they are and which property
beats.successCriteria: They identified themselves and the address

beats.intent: Get a clear description of what is wrong and since when
beats.successCriteria: The fault and duration were given

beats.intent: Claim not to have heard and make the learner repeat the key detail
beats.successCriteria: They repeated it, louder or differently

beats.intent: Suggest next week and let the learner argue for sooner
beats.successCriteria: They pushed back with a reason

beats.intent: Settle on a day and a time window
beats.successCriteria: A specific day and time were agreed

beats.intent: Get the learner to confirm the arrangement back and ask for a text

closing: Confirm the day and time, promise to text, and end the call
successCriteria: The learner coped with being asked to repeat themselves
They argued for a sooner visit
They read the arrangement back before hanging up
